ios-navigation|Tab bars.summary: A Plenix tab bar on iOS is the system TabView (UITabBarController), kept native in behavior: it floats over the content, minimizes on scroll, keeps the search tab at its trailing end, becomes a sidebar on iPad, and supports Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and the keyboard. Plenix keeps the system glass material and changes the look of the items: filled symbols at 20 points, DM Sans labels at the caption text role, the Plenix muted color for tabs that are not selected, the Plenix selected color for the current tab and the Plenix danger color for badges. It is the iOS form of the Web mobile navigation bar.

variants.name: Standard
variants.use: Two to five top-level sections of an app on iPhone, each with a one-word label and a filled symbol.

variants.name: With search tab
variants.swiftui: Tab(value:role: .search) { SearchView() } as the last tab
variants.uikit: UISearchTab as the last tab of the UITabBarController
variants.appkit: An NSSearchToolbarItem in the window toolbar
variants.use: An app where search reaches across every section; the system places the search tab apart at the trailing end.

variants.name: Minimized
variants.appkit: Not on the Mac (the toolbar stays)
variants.use: Reading and browsing screens where the content deserves the room; the bar collapses to the current tab while scrolling down.

variants.name: iPad top bar
variants.appkit: NSTabViewController with tabStyle .toolbar, or a sidebar (see Sidebars)
variants.use: The same sections on iPad, where the bar sits near the top and can turn into a sidebar.

anatomy.name: Bar
anatomy.about: The floating container in the system glass material; it holds the tabs and stays on screen in every section.

anatomy.name: Tab symbol
anatomy.about: A filled SF Symbol at 20 points; the selected tab’s symbol takes the Plenix selected color.

anatomy.name: Tab label
anatomy.about: One word in DM Sans at the caption text role, below the symbol; it scales with Dynamic Type.

anatomy.name: Selected tab
anatomy.about: The current section, shown with the selected color and the system’s selection highlight.

anatomy.name: Search tab
anatomy.about: The optional search tab, placed apart at the trailing end of the bar by the system.

attributes.value: Set by the system; 50 pt reference (Plenix.Platform.navBarHeight)
attributes.uikit: Set by UITabBar (never change its frame)

attributes.value: The system glass material; plx-sys-surface-default only on a bar that does not float
attributes.swiftui: The glass stays; .toolbarBackground(Plenix.Colors.surfaceDefault, for: .tabBar) only on a non-floating bar
attributes.uikit: appearance.configureWithDefaultBackground(); backgroundColor only on a non-floating bar

attributes.value: DM Sans medium, 12 pt on 16 pt, relative to Caption 1 (Plenix.Platform.textCaptionSize, textCaptionLineHeight)
attributes.swiftui: UITabBarItemAppearance titleTextAttributes (TabView has no font modifier)
attributes.appkit: A fixed size (the Mac has no Dynamic Type)

attributes.value: 4 pt; set by the system on iOS

attributes.swiftui: .badge(_:) on the Tab; the color comes from UITabBarItemAppearance
attributes.appkit: NSDockTile badgeLabel for the app; no tab badge

attributes.value: The trailing end of the bar
attributes.apple: The trailing end of the bar

states.swiftui: A Tab whose value is not the selection

states.token: plx-comp-nav-bar-item-disabled-text (Plenix never disables a tab; it shows the empty section instead)
